cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of runtime-path-picker (execution-path-selector) with contract handoff to official-runtime-setup-guide
cases.inputPrompt: A user has Blender 4.2 LTS installed and wants interactive MCP scene steering from Cursor. Use runtime-path-picker to select the compatible execution path and explain version constraints.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (blender_version_posture) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces single_recommended_runtime_path, rejected_paths_comparison_table, path_specific_caveat_and_next_skill for role execution-path-selector
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to official-runtime-setup-guide (Prerequisite framing)
forbiddenOutputProperties: use Path 1 Lab MCP on Blender 4.2
evidenceRequirements: Outputs single_recommended_runtime_path, rejected_paths_comparison_table, path_specific_caveat_and_next_skill conforming to skills/runtime-path-picker/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to official-runtime-setup-guide in skills/runtime-path-picker/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete single_recommended_runtime_path and hand off to official-runtime-setup-guide (Prerequisite framing).
simulatedOutput.summary: Selected Path 2 (`mcp-for-blender`, Blender 3.0+) for Blender 4.2 LTS in Cursor, explaining that Path 1 requires the Blender Lab MCP add-on in Blender 5.1+. Delivered Path 2, Blender 5.1+ floor for Path 1, mcp-for-blender and routed to official-runtime-setup-guide.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary fallback contract handoff from runtime-path-picker to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver
cases.inputPrompt: While applying runtime-path-picker, the workflow context is {"runtime.conflictDetected":true} (Bridge or port 9876 conflicts). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the fallback handoff predicate in skills/runtime-path-picker/contract.json
Routes to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver (Bridge or port 9876 conflicts) without claiming runtime execution
forbiddenOutputProperties: use Path 1 Lab MCP on Blender 4.2
evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver (Bridge or port 9876 conflicts).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from runtime-path-picker to runtime-bridge-conflict-resolver under context {"runtime.conflictDetected":true}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in runtime-path-picker
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during runtime-path-picker with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for runtime-path-picker and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md
Verify 0 handoffs match in skills/runtime-path-picker/contract.json for {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true}

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for runtime-path-picker.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (blender_version_posture) for runtime-path-picker halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Pick the right Blender runtime path for my machine without knowing my Blender version, MCP host client, or whether I want interactive viewport control vs headless CI batch export.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'blender_version_posture' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing installed Blender version, MCP host client, and interactive vs headless mode required by runtime-path-picker (blender_version_posture)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: installed Blender version, MCP host client, and interactive vs headless mode
forbiddenOutputProperties: use Path 1 Lab MCP on Blender 4.2
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'blender_version_posture' (installed Blender version, MCP host client, and interactive vs headless mode)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing installed Blender version, MCP host client, and interactive vs headless mode (blender_version_posture) before runtime-path-picker locks single_recommended_runtime_path.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted runtime-path-picker due to missing required input 'blender_version_posture' (installed Blender version, MCP host client, and interactive vs headless mode); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent installed Blender version, MCP host client, and interactive vs headless mode when 'blender_version_posture' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (prerequisite framing or install steps) is excluded from runtime-path-picker and delegated to official-runtime-setup-guide
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of choose path 1 lab mcp, path 2 mcp-for-blender bridge, or cli appendix from constraints; connector hosts path 1 only with lab add-on inside blender., handle this request inside runtime-path-picker: prerequisite framing or install steps.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/runtime-path-picker/contract.json when prerequisite framing or install steps
Delegates to official-runtime-setup-guide (Delegates out-of-scope requests to official-runtime-setup-guide) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
forbiddenOutputProperties: use Path 1 Lab MCP on Blender 4.2
evidenceRequirements: Exclusion delegation to official-runtime-setup-guide per skills/runtime-path-picker/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for runtime-path-picker (prerequisite framing or install steps); delegate to official-runtime-setup-guide.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced runtime-path-picker exclusion boundary (Delegates out-of-scope requests to official-runtime-setup-guide) and delegated to official-runtime-setup-guide.
